1. Scope — Covers dimensions and material for slotted clamps used in holding work pieces in place 
when they are being machined. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 Dimensions for the slotted clamps shall be as given in Table 1 . 

3. Designation — A slotted clamp having d = 9 mm and / = 60 mm shall be designated as : 

Slotted Clamp 9x60 IS : 6082 

4. Material — Steel suitably hardened and tempered to a tensile strength of 750 to 850 N/mm 3 . 

5. Finish — The slotted clamps shall b8 free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. These shall 
also be free from sharp corners. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable antlcorrosive surface treatment shall be given to the slotted clamps. 

6.2 The slotted clamps shall be packed in accordance with best trade practice. 

7. Marking 

7.1 The slotted clamps shall be marked at an appropriate place with designation, manufacturer's name 
or trade-mark. 

7.2 fSf Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1971. The committee responsible for formulation of this 
standard decided to revise the same to bring it in line with other standards on clamps, which are also 
being revised, in respect of material, roughness values, tolerance and rationalisation of sizes. 

In the present revision, two sizes of slotted clamps for screw size M5 have been deleted. Four 
more sizes of slotted clamps have been included to suit screw sizes M24 and M30. 



Adopted 29 May 1985
